subject: Recap + trial handshake: eval spec, sample logs request, and owners
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@signalpeak.ai>, Priya Kumar <priya.k@signalpeak.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-07-12T16:12:00-04:00
Subject: Recap + trial handshake: eval spec, sample logs request, and owners

Alex / Priya — thanks for the call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a single plan for the trial evaluation. Please confirm or correct anything below.

High-level goal
- Run a 2-week trial to validate Redwood inference against SignalPeak’s real-world question-answering flows (customer support + internal knowledge). Key metrics: answer accuracy on labeled prompts, end-to-end latency (95th pct), and per-token cost.

Success criteria (initial proposal)
- Accuracy: >= 82% weighted F1 on the labeled eval set (we'll provide grading rubric)
- Latency: p95 generation < 600ms (50-token median context)
- Cost: token cost per 1k < agreed threshold (we'll refine once logs available)
- No PII leakage in returned output; security sweep passes 

What we need from SignalPeak
1) Sample prompt/log export: 2–5k anonymized interaction records in JSONL (one record per prompt-response pair). Fields: prompt_text, conversation_context (optional), expected_answer (if available), and metadata: channel, timestamp, locale.
2) A small labeled eval set of ~300 gold prompts with expected answers (spread across priority intents).
3) Any redaction rules to apply before ingestion (PII fields to scrub).

Proposed ownership & timeline
- SignalPeak: deliver anonymized sample logs + eval set by 2027-07-14 EOD (Priya/Alex)
- Redwood: ingest, run eval, and present results by 2027-07-21 (Marissa lead)
- Follow-up demo + decision meeting: 2027-07-22 (Vanessa to coordinate)

Transport & security options
- S3 (recommended): presigned upload to s3://signalpeak-redwood-trial/ (we can generate a time-limited presigned URL)
- Google Drive (for smaller bundles) — share folder link
- If you require additional controls (VPC transfer, encrypted tarball), let us know; we can provide Secure Transfer playbook.

Attachments I’m including: a one-page evaluation success matrix and a checklist for sample exports.

Next steps / Asks right now
- Priya/Alex: confirm you can deliver a 2–5k sample and 300-label eval set by 2027-07-14. If not, propose a realistic delivery date.
- SignalPeak: let us know if any fields must be redacted beyond names/emails (we will provide a sample scrub script).
- Once confirmed, Ben will send the presigned S3 link and ingestion instructions.

Thanks — looking forward to getting the trial running.

—
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0172

Attachments: evaluation_success_matrix.xlsx, sample_export_checklist.txt

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@signalpeak.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Kumar <priya.k@signalpeak.ai>
Date: 2027-07-12T17:03:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Recap + trial handshake: eval spec, sample logs request, and owners

Thanks Vanessa — that aligns with our notes. A couple quick clarifications from our side: 

- Redaction: We can remove clear PII (names, email addresses, phone numbers) and replace with tokens (e.g., <NAME>, <EMAIL>). We'll also remove full account numbers — but we need Redwood to confirm you won't require raw account IDs for matching.
- Size: We can produce a 3k record export + a 300-record labeled set by 2027-07-15 in the morning instead of EOD; engineering has a slot on Wed to run the pipeline.
- Sample: attaching one small sample file (signalpeak_sample_logs.jsonl) to illustrate schema.

Questions: 
1) Does Redwood have a preferred schema for the "expected_answer" field (string vs. multi-span)? We can provide both, but want to avoid rework.
2) For latency measurements, do you want us to include raw upstream times or will Redwood run synthetic replay?

We can do the S3 upload. Please send the presigned URL and any required upload manifest.

—
Alex Johnson
Head of Integrations | SignalPeak AI
alex.johnson@signalpeak.ai | +1 (646) 555-0123

On Mon, Jul 12, 2027 at 4:12 PM Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Alex / Priya — thanks for the call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a single plan for the trial evaluation. Please confirm or correct anything below.

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@signalpeak.ai>, Priya Kumar <priya.k@signalpeak.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-07-13T09:28:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Recap + trial handshake: eval spec, sample logs request, and owners

Alex — great, thanks for the quick turnaround. Couple of implementation notes from the ingestion side: 

- Schema: we prefer expected_answer as a single-string field for the labeled eval set (gold answer). For qualitative spans, include an optional array field "spans" — but gold scoring will use expected_answer when provided. If you can include both, we'll map automatically.
- Sample size & diversity: 3k is perfect. Please try to include at least 150 examples from high-priority intents (we'll provide a short intent mapping list).
- Upload: I'll generate a presigned S3 URL and a small upload manifest template (filename pattern + ingestion checksum). Expect that from me by EOD 2027-07-13.
- Security: we'll run the ingestion in a sandbox with no persistent storage retention beyond the trial window (14 days) and provide a log of access events. If you need an encrypted transfer, indicate and we'll add an encrypted tar option.

Owners & immediate actions
- Alex/Priya: confirm redaction and upload availability (target 2027-07-15 morning).
- Ben: provide presigned S3 link + manifest (action: Ben — due 2027-07-13 EOD).
- Marissa: run the eval and produce the report (action: Marissa — delivery 2027-07-21).

I'll send the presigned link in a follow-up.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

—
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0188

From: Priya Kumar <priya.k@signalpeak.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@signalpeak.ai>
Date: 2027-07-14T09:08:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Recap + trial handshake: eval spec, sample logs request, and owners

Thanks Ben — we confirm and will proceed as discussed. Quick update: 

- Delivery: uploaded a 3,225 record JSONL to s3://signalpeak-redwood-trial/sample-exports/2027-07-14/ (files: signalpeak_sample_logs.jsonl, signalpeak_eval_300.jsonl).
- Redaction: names and emails replaced with <NAME>/<EMAIL>; account numbers hashed using SHA256 and stored in a separate metadata field (account_hash). We are not providing raw account IDs.
- Expected answer format: we included a single-string expected_answer for the labeled 300 set and an optional "spans" array for context.
- Access: the presigned URLs expire in 7 days; if you need longer retention, please advise.

Links: s3://signalpeak-redwood-trial/sample-exports/2027-07-14/ (access via presigned URL — sent to Ben via separate email). Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cSignalPeakTrial (contains the sample schema and redaction notes).

Next: Ben — confirm you received the manifest and will begin ingestion. Marissa — let us know if you need any additional fields before you start evaluation.

—
Priya Kumar
Director, Platform Engineering | SignalPeak AI
priya.k@signalpeak.ai | +1 (212) 555-0199
